text: A MENU ROW THAT LEAVES THE SITE NOW SAYS SO EVERYWHERE IT APPEARS. The new-tab mark reached the simple dropdown only: the NavSheet's three kinds of row carried none, and a `MegaMenuItem` never carried one at all, so the mobile menu's off-site rows were unmarked against WCAG 3.2.5. An external mega row now shows the mark in place of its chevron — which promises "deeper into this site", the wrong promise — and it stays visible rather than appearing on hover, because a touch screen never hovers.
